sections.content:
7 bugs in KT/handoff CLI:
1. Corruption warning spam - changed logger.warning to logger.debug
2. kt list missing tags param - added to adapter
3. .get() on objects in cmd_kt_list - added _get_attr helper
4. Missing adapter methods - added get_knowledge_transfer, append_kt_section, finalize_knowledge_transfer
5. .get() on objects in cmd_kt_show - used _get_attr throughout
6. finalize missing params - added handoff_to, instructions
7. kt create not persisting - added generate_kt_id, proper CDG store write
sections.title: Bugs Fixed
